components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Runs the main action in a compact workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-amber); color: var(--color-on-accent); padding: 10px 20px; font: 600 14px/20px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-amber-glow); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Offers a reversible or lower-priority action beside the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-stone); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-basalt); color: var(--color-fog); padding: 10px 20px; font: 500 14px/20px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber) 30%, transparent); color: var(--color-light); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Collects credentials, endpoints, and configuration values.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-endpoint">Endpoint URL</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-endpoint" type="url" placeholder="http://homeassistant.local:8123">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: var(--color-dust); font: 500 12px/16px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-stone); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-basalt); color: var(--color-light); padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 14px/20px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-dust) 60%, transparent); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-ash); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-amber); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber) 30%, transparent); outline: none; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Marks the current authenticated route without overpowering the page.
components.html: Activity
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-fog); padding: 10px 12px; font: 500 14px/20px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-stone) 40%, transparent); color: var(--color-cloud); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber) 8%, transparent); color: var(--color-amber); } .ds-nav-item-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4px auto 4px 0; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; background: var(--color-amber); }

components.name: Theme Selector
components.description: Stores a System, Light, or Dark preference at the shell edge.
components.css: .ds-theme-selector { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 4px; width: 170px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-stone) 60%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 80%, transparent); padding: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); } .ds-theme-option { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-dust); padding: 6px 8px; font: 500 10px/14px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-theme-option svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-theme-option:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-stone) 40%, transparent); color: var(--color-light); } .ds-theme-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber) 60%, transparent); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-theme-option[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--color-obsidian); color: var(--color-amber); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Frames login and setup content over the observatory canvas.
components.html:
Configure Lucia

Connect the dashboard to Home Assistant.
components.css: .ds-glass-panel { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-stone) 60%, transparent); border-radius: 16px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 80%, transparent); color: var(--color-cloud); padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 0 10px -3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber) 12%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-glass-panel:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber) 25%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 90%, transparent); } .ds-glass-panel:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber) 25%, transparent); } .ds-glass-panel h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--color-light); font: 600 20px/28px 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-glass-panel p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--color-fog); font: 400 14px/20px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Success Status
components.description: Confirms a connection or completed setup step without using the primary accent.
components.css: .ds-status-success { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-sage) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-sage) 10%, transparent); color: var(--color-sage); padding: 12px; font: 400 14px/20px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-success:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-sage) 45%, transparent); } .ds-status-success:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Agent Node
components.description: Shows a processing agent inside the live mesh graph.
components.html: OrchestratorProcessing Prompt...
components.css: .ds-agent-node { display: inline-flex; min-width: 120px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-amber-dim); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber) 14%, transparent); color: var(--color-amber); padding: 8px 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-dim) 25%, transparent); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: all 300ms; } .ds-agent-node:hover { border-color: var(--color-amber); } .ds-agent-node:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-agent-node span { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; } .ds-agent-node strong { color: var(--color-amber); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; } .ds-agent-node small { color: var(--color-amber); font-size: 10px; line-height: 14px; }

narrative.overview:
Lucia Observatory is an Operate-mode system for long technical sessions. It keeps the authenticated dashboard dense and predictable while warm mineral neutrals, amber focus, and small changes in depth preserve the product's identity in both bright and dim rooms.

Theme choice extends the existing shell instead of becoming a separate destination. System, Light, and Dark use one semantic role vocabulary, so setup, login, navigation, charts, dialogs, and operational pages keep the same hierarchy when the resolved mode changes.
keyCharacteristics: Compact operational controls and route-first composition
Warm neutral surfaces with amber reserved for focus, selection, and progress
One semantic token vocabulary across light and dark modes
Borders, translucency, and low glows instead of heavy elevation

rules.name: The Semantic Remap Rule
rules.body: Page and component code uses semantic tokens such as `void`, `basalt`, `fog`, `light`, `amber`, `sage`, and `rose`. Only the root theme definition changes their values; page components do not carry light-specific or dark-specific classes.

rules.name: The Amber Restraint Rule
rules.body: Amber marks focus, selection, primary action, progress, or active system state. Neutral surfaces carry ordinary structure.

rules.name: The Compact Type Rule
rules.body: Operational text stays between `0.625rem` and `1.5rem`. Larger display type is absent from the shipped dashboard.

rules.name: The Route-First Rule
rules.body: Theme controls stay at the shell edge. They do not displace the current workflow or become a page-level feature.

rules.name: The Restrained Depth Rule
rules.body: Borders and tonal layering do the structural work. Glow identifies a live or branded focal point; it does not decorate ordinary containers.

dos: Do use the semantic color roles from `index.css` in every page and component.
Do keep the System, Light, and Dark options together and preserve their storage, pre-render resolution, and operating-system behavior.
Do place the selector at the upper-right edge on public screens and in the sidebar footer after authentication.
Do expose selection with `aria-pressed`, label icon-only controls, hide decorative icons from assistive technology, and retain visible keyboard focus.
Do reserve amber for focus, selection, primary action, progress, and active system state.
donts: Don't add mode-specific classes or raw light/dark palette values to page components; remap semantic tokens at the root.
Don't promote appearance controls into the primary route content.
Don't use heavy shadows or broad glows on ordinary operational cards.
Don't replace semantic success, error, information, and progress states with amber alone.
